First, I locate episode number 57 in the series. Looking at the "no in series" column, row 57 corresponds to:  
- Title: "family business"  
- US viewers (million): 2.77  

The statement says: "episode number 57 in the series had 2.75 thousand us viewers."  
Note: The table gives viewers in millions, so 2.77 million = 2,770 thousand.  
The statement says 2.75 thousand, which is 0.00275 million — much smaller.  

Comparing:  
2.77 million (actual) vs. 2.75 thousand (stated) → these are not the same.  

Thus, the statement is false.  

Final Answer: No
